title: Between-phonation RPDE–DFA covariance does not demonstrate incremental Parkinson voice prediction across public cohorts
abstract: RPDE–DFA covariance changed external Brier loss from 0.642419 to 0.642489; baseline-minus-augmented gain -0.000070, 95% source-refit/target identifier-group bootstrap interval [-0.030066, 0.040618]. Incremental predictive value was not demonstrated. Source80 people;target32 identifier groups despite31 documented people. Strong domain shift and failed source prediction limit interpretation. AI-authored,author-self-checked;not independent peer review.
